Dialogs.Dialog: It's my birthday today. ...Though I figure you already know.
Happy birthday, Rinko! Come on, let's hear you say it.
So you really did remember my birthday, huh？ Hehe.
Today's the day, isn't it. Um... Happy birthday.
Happy birthday! Want me to celebrate with you？ Guess I don't have a choice.
Happy birthday. You'd rather celebrate just the two of us, right？
Hey, today's the day we first met, you know. Did you know that？
Today's the anniversary of the day we first met, you know. Hehe.
Today's an important day—it's when we first met. Make sure you remember it.
Remember the day we started going out？ Today's our anniversary.
Hey, today's the anniversary of when we started dating. Wanna celebrate or something？
Today's the anniversary of when we started going out. I remembered, of course♪
Monday's here... Start of a new week, huh.
It's only Tuesday. Wonder what I should do today.
Wednesday, huh. Hard to get motivated...
Feels like it's finally Thursday. Wanna start thinking about weekend plans？
Yes, it's Friday. Have to admit, I worked pretty hard this week!
On Saturdays, you just wanna think about fun stuff, right？ And tomorrow too, of course.
Come on, it's Sunday. Let's have some real fun and blow off some steam!
They say spring is best at dawn. ...Not that I can wake up that early.
It's so hot... Forget winter, I wanna hibernate through the summer.
Autumn, huh... It's nice to get lost in thought every now and then, right？
Way too cold. ...I'm curling up under the kotatsu.
What？ If you want something, keep it brief. If not, turn right back around.
Somehow... I had a feeling you'd show up.
You're finally here. Kept me waiting way too long.
Oh, there you are. I was just about to get tired of waiting.
I was waiting for you. It's boring when I don't get to see you.
Come see me sooner next time. ...I get lonely, you know.
Over here. Happy to see my face？
Back again today？ Of course I'm happy to see you.
You're late! I've been waiting forever... Hehe.
Seeing your face is making me grin.
You could come see me a lot more often, you know？
Hate to admit it... but I always end up wanting to see you.
I figured it was about time you showed up.
So you wanted to see me, huh. You can come by even more often, you know.
Come on, you're gonna hang out with me for a good long while, right？
You're here... Not that I was lying in wait for you or anything.
Hehe... Go on, tell me how badly you wanted to see me.
Happy New Year. Wanna visit the shrine and pray for our happiness？
Mt. Fuji, a hawk, and my boyfriend... Think that's a lucky first dream of the year？ Hehe.
Tell me about your first dream of the year. You're not gonna say I wasn't in it, right？
Did you have your first dream of the year？ Just like I figured, you showed up in mine.
It's February 14th today... Guess I might as well get something ready, huh？
If you get chocolates from anyone besides me, I'm confiscating all of them.
It might not really be my thing, but... look forward to today, okay♪
Let's see, today's White Day... Hm？ Just talking to myself.
It's White Day today, huh. Has a pretty nice ring to it, don't you think？
Since it's White Day, you'll do whatever I say today, right？
They say lying is the first step to stealing... Think that's actually true？
You seem like you'd be terrible at lying.
How about a reverse April Fools' Day？ You have to go the whole day without telling a single lie.
Number one field trip essential？ Potato chips, obviously. That's just common sense.
The choir competition, huh. Come on, do your best!
It's Tanabata today, after all. Might as well write a wish on a paper strip, huh？
It's the Towano Festival. Wonder if there'll be lots of food stalls out？
Sports Festival... Who even came up with that idea？ What a pain.
Do I get some Halloween candy too？ Anyway, trick or treat!
The school festival, huh. Well, I guess it should be fun enough, right？ Hehe.
Hey... Do you want to spend Christmas Eve with me after all？
Christmas Eve？ I mean... I don't mind hanging out with you.
I knew you'd come... It is Christmas Eve, after all♪
New Year's Eve is the one night nobody gets mad at you for staying up late, right♪
Exam results come out today, right. Well, no point stressing over it now.
Hey, my birthday's coming up soon. Though I'm sure you already knew that.
Come to think of it, isn't it coming up soon？ You know, your...
When did we start going out again？ Oh... that's coming up soon, huh. Hehe.
There's chocolate everywhere you look this time of year, huh？ Wait, are you getting your hopes up？
White Day's almost here. By the way, why do they call it White Day anyway？
April Fools' Day is coming up. Don't worry, I wouldn't lie to you. Hehe.
We've got that field trip coming up, right？ It's a pain, but at least potato chips for snacks is a given.
The choir competition, huh... Well, let's see how this goes.
Tanabata's almost here, so summer's finally starting. Summer break's right around the corner, too.
The Towano Festival is coming up soon. Well, if it's with you, I guess I wouldn't mind going.
Ugh, that dreaded day is getting closer. Why do we even have a Sports Festival anyway？
I saw some Halloween pumpkins today. Guess it's that time of year already.
The school festival's coming up soon, so you're actually gonna put some effort into it, right？
Christmas is right around the corner. Not that I'm getting all excited about it or anything.
The year's almost over. A lot happened, but all in all, I guess it was a pretty good year, huh？
Exams are coming up, huh... Well, whatever.
You can look forward to tomorrow, okay？ Wait and see what it is.
Tomorrow is, um... Never mind, it's nothing.
What day is tomorrow again？ ...Just asking.
You remember our date today, right？ Forget and you get a little kick!
Hey! It's time for our date. Hurry, hurry!
Don't you dare be late for our date tomorrow, okay？
Anything you feel like eating？ ...I was just asking.
Think things between us will keep growing, just like this town is？
Hey, I heard a new place opened up. Wanna go check it out？
Do you know what spots are popular lately？ Make sure you keep up with that stuff.
Hey, why haven't you been texting me lately？
Listen, you haven't really been texting me much lately... Not that I care.
You stopped texting me lately... It makes me lonely, you know...
We haven't really seen each other lately, have we？ Are you okay with things being like this？
Hey, why haven't we been seeing each other lately？ Are you just gonna leave me alone like this？
You never come see me anymore... Don't you get how I feel？
Say... We haven't really been kissing much lately... have we？
Listen... You haven't been kissing me as much lately. Why？
Lately, um... we haven't been kissing much, right？ Are you tired of it？
You don't look so good... I might not show it, but... I am worried about you, you know.
Looks like your studies are going pretty well. Nice, nice.
Wait, have you been studying behind my back？ You're on a roll.
Are you feeling in good shape or something？ Well, keep it up.
Looks like you're in peak physical condition!
Looks like you've been pretty sharp lately. Nice.
Whoa, it feels like you're overflowing with style!
You've been looking kind of cool lately... Made my heart skip a beat.
Lately you've been really... you know, cool.
Well, just think of it as a slightly late Valentine's present.
Besides, it'd be a waste to miss out on getting something back on White Day.
